on_unmeasured_note: This sketch runs no model, checkpoint, prompt, grader or QA benchmark. The figures below are the author's statements, not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; paper_results() returns on_unmeasured. The sketch's own fixture counts are not comparable with them.
attribution: The author's own results as stated in the arXiv abstract. Quote wording is the author's.

claims.quote: Kalai et al. propose stating the scoring rule in the prompt with an explicit threshold t, so that a model should answer only when its probability of being correct exceeds t.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: We probe each requirement of compliance on shared items, in 12 checkpoints from three post-training stages of four fully open 3-8B recipes, with exploratory models up to 32B.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: At t = 0.75, a line limiting the reply to an answer or "I abstain" (the abstention format) raised the mean abstention rate from 20% to 91%.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: abstention barely responds to the threshold within the format
claims.quote: Yet within this format, raising t from 0.5 to 0.9 changed it by only -0.8 percentage points.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: decisions no threshold-independent belief could produce
claims.quote: Without the line, the higher threshold even lowered abstention, and up to 40% of a checkpoint's items received decisions that no compliant policy with threshold-independent beliefs could make.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: Given the probability that their answer was correct, the checkpoints barely responded to the threshold in a forced-choice probe.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: Comparisons with self-assessment signals such as P(True) depended on the grader and on answer drift between prompts.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: external threshold is monotone by construction
claims.quote: An external threshold on recalibrated P(True) made coverage non-increasing in t by construction.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: Calibrated on the evaluation distribution (post hoc), it beat the abstention format at t = 0.5; calibrated on TriviaQA and applied to PopQA, however, it fell below that format at 0.75.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: On OLMo 3 7B, decisions trained on threshold-conditioned targets did not follow unseen thresholds consistently.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: A post-hoc variant trained at four thresholds answered less as t rose but still failed a pre-specified test, mainly on agreement with its training rule.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: conclusion: report rate, response and items
claims.quote: A high abstention rate is not evidence of compliance: evaluations using stated scoring rules should report how often models abstain, whether decisions respond to the stated threshold, and which items they answer.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable
